description: S59 T6 (EV12): environment.provisions is the ledger, read the same way whether or not a container exists — id, the environment and root it belongs to, the backend, the driver's handle, its STATE from the closed set (provisioning, ready, tearing_down, removed, failed), and the timestamps of each transition. `lastError` carries the driver's own sentence when a removal failed: the ledger records the failure it could not complete rather than pretending.
